title: Lacto Sour Slovakian Sunflower Seeds Skillet
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring sunflower seeds, lacto vegetarian friendly, with a sour and chewy texture, cooked in a cast iron skillet. This recipe is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the cast iron skillet over medium heat, adding sunflower oil to coat the bottom.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Add sunflower seeds and cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes or until lightly toasted.
Stir in yuzu juice and sour cream, combining well.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until the seeds are chewy and the liquid has thickened.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
